summary: Static-only verification of Sprint 6.2.0 Shoonya OAuth migration. All required checks passed independently: shoonya_oauth_harness 9/9 PASS, fyers isolation & reconnect harnesses ALL PASS (no regression), pnpm -r typecheck 6/6 PASS, pnpm -r build all workspaces PASS, and NestJS boot-sanity mapped all 4 Shoonya routes (/brokers/shoonya/login, /brokers/shoonya/callback, /api/brokers/shoonya/login, /api/brokers/shoonya/callback) with the expected PrismaClientInitializationError (DATABASE_URL missing) crashing only AFTER full DI graph and route resolution — exactly the documented acceptable outcome for this DB-less pod.
